name: fusion-league
description: Fusion Turf - Turf Booking & League Management Platform

scripts.build: npm run build:server && npm run build:client
scripts.db:migrate: cd server && npx prisma migrate deploy
scripts.db:seed: cd server && npx prisma db seed
scripts.setup: npm install && cd server && npm install && npx prisma generate && npx prisma migrate deploy && npx prisma db seed && cd ../client && npm install
scripts.verify: npm run build && npm run check:budgets && cd server && npm test && npm audit --audit-level=high && cd ../client && npm test && npm audit --audit-level=high
